text: SELECT s.player_id, s.player_name, COUNT(*) AS double_doubles FROM "nba_golden"."dev"."player_game_stats" s WHERE strftime('%Y', s.game_date) = '2017' AND s.played = 1 AND ((CASE WHEN s.pts >= 10 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN s.reb >= 10 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN s.ast >= 10 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN s.stl >= 10 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN s.blk >= 10 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) >= 2 GROUP BY s.player_id, s.player_name ORDER BY double_doubles DESC, s.player_name ASC LIMIT 10
